meta.title: SAP MM (Purchase Requisition): on failure — PR held in 'Sync Pending' state
gaps: Configure SAP MM integration INT-002 with the specified RFC/API key parameters and CONF-INT-001 sync mode
Make the SAP MM endpoint fail or become unreachable
Approve a Procol purchase requisition and trigger PO creation in SAP
Observe and verify that the PR is held in Sync Pending with an alert, log, or retry record and is not silently dropped
